summary: Strengthen post-award controls for notices, variations, EOT and payments. Explore practical construction contract management training and enquire today.
lede: Post-award construction contract management helps contract teams administer claims, variations and payment decisions using project records. For contract managers, quantity surveyors, project directors and engineers, the training covers notice tracking, variation valuation and extension-of-time evidence assessment. Participants also practise payment review and performance reporting with Excel-based controls, while exploring AI-assisted document classification at a conceptual level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who administer live infrastructure and construction contracts, assess commercial events or report post-award project performance.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with construction project delivery and contract documents is recommended. No programming is required. The exercises use contract records and spreadsheet-based analysis; advanced delay analysis and AI-assisted document classification are introduced conceptually or applied through guided case work, not taught as technical implementation.
